forecastingTypeId.title: Forecasting Type ID
forecastingTypeId.description: Salesforce ID of the active ForecastingType, from Get_Forecasting_Context.

periodId.title: Period ID
periodId.description: Salesforce ID of the current ForecastingPeriod, from Get_Forecasting_Context.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Salesforce User ID (005...) of the forecast owner the note is generated for, from Get_Forecasting_Context. Must be the running user — note generation is self-only and rejects any other owner.

territoryId.title: Territory ID
territoryId.description: Optional Territory2 ID for territory-hierarchy forecast types. Required at runtime for such types (the action rejects a missing territory); blank for role-hierarchy types.
